title: Visual Asset Composer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 121. SCOPE CUT (see dispatch.py's own module-section docstring): the ~34 'Canvas for X' lockups, the device-mockup library, approved anonymised Power BI screenshots and the icon set prompt.md names do not exist as files anywhere in this repository, so this PR cannot compose a free-form template-library render or run the deterministic palette/clear-space/contrast/OCR checks prompt.md describes -- there is nothing real to check without either those files or a live Canva render, and the latter is blocked (canva_dry_run() stays true pending the open 'Canva refresh token' decision the blueprint's own change log names as 'unlock C; blocks Fn 121'). What this PR ships instead is real: reusing function 45's own already-shipped Canva Bulk Create CSV manifest shape (one brand_template_id, one row per option) and mcp-canva client, it drafts up to three on-template row-set options differing on one declared axis, as a content.visual_variant card. Propose-only -- no function in this dispatch table has an 'on card chosen' callback today (Fn 114/115/118 set the same precedent), so this never itself submits to mcp-canva.

brand_template_id.description: A Canva Bulk Create template id, supplied by whoever triggers this function -- this repo has no template catalog to look one up from.

copy_source.description: The chosen content option's copy that needs a visual.

axis.description: The one declared axis the three options differ on (layout density, proof-forward vs headline-forward, dark vs light lockup).

csv_row.description: One Canva Bulk Create manifest row for this variant -- column name to fill value, matching function 45's own manifest column shape.
